description: WHEN TO USE: To see the scan history for a project — all past and current scans with their statuses. REQUIRES: project_id from lbm_list_projects. RETURNS: Compact CSV with scan_id, status, created_at, results_count (default). Set include_all_fields=true for full JSON.

include_all_fields.description: Set true for full JSON response. Default: false (compact CSV — recommended).

status.description: Optional: filter by status (queued, running, completed, partial, failed)

name: lbm_list_scans
